_comment: Wording of the reports: check-ins, Saving, Thought and Exposure Journals (core/checkin_reports.py, core/checkin_pdf.py). Each conclusion is a rule-based sentence that appears only when the numbers behind it are there; the thresholds are in checkin_reports.py. They describe what she recorded and never explain, predict or diagnose. {placeholders} are filled in by the code.
note: This report is made from what you finished in your journals in Mind Doc this {period}: check-ins, good moments, thought records and exposures, in your own ratings and words. It is not a clinical assessment, and nothing in it is a diagnosis.
closing: These are patterns in what you wrote, not a diagnosis.
questions_note: Each dot is one week's answers, placed between the lowest and highest they could be: higher means your answers said "more often". No score is shown.

conclusions.day_checkins: You did {n} of 3 check-ins that day ({slots}).
conclusions.day_mood_moved: Your mood went from {first} in the {first_slot} to {last} in the {last_slot}.
conclusions.day_mood_steady: Your mood stayed {label} through the day.
conclusions.day_stress_peak: Stress or worry was highest in the {high_slot} ({high}/10) and lowest in the {low_slot} ({low}/10).
conclusions.day_sleep: You slept {hours}, and rated your sleep "{quality}".
conclusions.day_strongest_feeling: The strongest feeling you named was {feeling} ({value}/10, in the {slot}).
conclusions.day_plan_2: It went roughly the way you had hoped.
conclusions.day_plan_1: It went partly the way you had hoped.
conclusions.day_plan_0: It did not really go the way you had hoped.
conclusions.checkins: You checked in {n} of {possible} times, on {days} of {total_days} days.
conclusions.not_enough: There were too few check-ins this {period} to see patterns yet; a few more will show them.
conclusions.calmest_slot: {slot}s were your calmest time: stress or worry averaged {low}/10, against {high}/10 in the {high_slot}s.
conclusions.best_mood_slot: Your mood was usually best in the {slot} ({best} out of 5, against {worst} in the {worst_slot}).
conclusions.sleep_mood: On days after under 6 hours of sleep your mood averaged {short} out of 5; after 6 hours or more, {enough}.
conclusions.better_days_activity: On your better days, "{activity}" came up most ({n} of {m} days).
conclusions.coping_top: You chose "{coping}" most often to cope ({n} times).
conclusions.top_feeling: "{feeling}" was the feeling you named most ({n} check-ins).
conclusions.best_day: Your best-rated day was {best} ({best_value}/10), and the hardest {hardest} ({hardest_value}/10).
conclusions.plan: Days went at least partly the way you had hoped on {n} of {m} evenings.
conclusions.mood_up: Your mood was higher than the {period} before ({now} against {before} out of 5).
conclusions.mood_up_small: Your mood was a little higher than the {period} before ({now} against {before} out of 5).
conclusions.mood_same: Your mood was about the same as the {period} before ({now} against {before} out of 5).
conclusions.mood_down_small: Your mood was a little lower than the {period} before ({now} against {before} out of 5).
conclusions.mood_down: Your mood was lower than the {period} before ({now} against {before} out of 5).
conclusions.stress_up: Stress or worry was higher than the {period} before ({now}/10 against {before}/10).
conclusions.stress_down: Stress or worry was lower than the {period} before ({now}/10 against {before}/10).
conclusions.saved: You saved {moments} in the Saving Journal.
conclusions.saved_lift: Your mood tended to be higher after savoring (about +{lift} on average).
conclusions.saved_feeling: "{feeling}" was the feeling you named most in your good moments.
conclusions.thought_done: You finished {records} in the Thought Journal.
conclusions.thought_belief: On average, your belief in the first thought eased by {drop} points.
conclusions.thought_trap: "{trap}" was the thinking pattern you noticed most.
conclusions.exposure_done: You did {exposures} in the Exposure Journal.
conclusions.exposure_partial: {n} of them you did in part, and that counts too.
conclusions.exposure_prediction: You predicted what you feared was {predicted}% likely; it happened {happened}% of the time.
